title: Account Review Criteria: Prior Agency Placements and Payment Inactivity for Two-Payment Settlement Pricing
content:
# Two-Payment Settlement — Dormancy Reductions

These criteria read two facts from the Placed Consumer Accounts records of the account a Two-Payment Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements would settle: the number of collection agencies that worked the account before this placement, and the consumer payments posted to it.

**Criterion.** Where two or more collection agencies worked the account before this placement and no consumer payment was posted to it with a date after the same calendar day twelve months before the offer date, the Two-Payment dormancy reduction of 3.0 points applies; where exactly one agency worked it before this placement and no consumer payment was posted in that same twelve-month span, the Two-Payment single-agency dormancy reduction of 1.5 points applies; in every other case the account carries no dormancy reduction for a Two-Payment offer.

## Decision table

| Agencies that worked the account before this placement | Consumer payment posted with a date after the same calendar day twelve months before the offer date | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | none | 3.0 percentage points |
| two or more | one or more | none |
| exactly one | none | 1.5 percentage points |
| exactly one | one or more | none |
| none | either | none |

## The twelve-month span (hypothetical dates)

For an offer dated the 15th of a month, the span opens after the 15th of the same month one year earlier: a consumer payment dated that earlier 15th falls outside the span, and one dated the 16th falls inside it and removes the reduction.
